review.notes: Full review. One P2 finding: densities, Papangelou intensity, GNZ and hard core are owned both here (1.3, 4.1) and by Layer 5 of the open PointProcesses roadmap (#417), which the text never names. Adversarial pass over all 8 layers with degenerate instances; every numerical Check recomputed and reproduced. Seeded sample (15 targets): mathematics verified for all; source text read only for Dereudre (arXiv:1701.08105v2), which supports 5.1-5.5; Moller-Waagepetersen 2004 and 2007, van Lieshout 2000 and 2019, Gaetan-Guyon and Ripley are paywalled and listed as not verifiable. Pins: Mathlib tvDist, klDiv, Kernel.IsIrreducible, IsReversible, Invariant opened; pinned Tau Ceti lacks expNeg, IsIntegerValued, IsPoissonRandomMeasure (small correction). Elaboration: 54 sorry warnings only; 105 elaborated signatures compared; 6 one-tactic probes, 1 closed. Dependency check: 0 problems. One automatic form check set aside as a false positive (a section comment heading #check pins).
